name: San Lung wine
summary: Rượu san lùng is the third drink poured at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls, beside táo mèo and plum wine.
origin: Sa Pa, at the Silver Waterfall stalls.
howToEat: Try a cup beside the other two stall drinks.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ.
seoTitle: San Lung wine in Sapa — a falls-stall drink
seoDescription: Rượu san lùng at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls, poured beside táo mèo and plum wine.
